text_block_list.text: —The day of the Takarazuka Kinen is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
A head-to-head clash between the "Out of this World Escape Artist" Silence Suzuka
and the "Empress" Air Groove...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka was incredible at the Kinko Sho, after all.
Will she pull off a runaway victory again?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Still, Air Groove's racing sense is top-notch! Her late-race burst is magnificent too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
You bet!
Urrgh, I can't wait to see the race!

Silence Suzuka's performance at the Kinko Sho
and Air Groove's sheer dominance as the "Empress"
generated massive excitement and towering expectations!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's blazing hot out there, isn't it?

With those words,
Air Groove let out a single breath.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then... There is no need for further words.
